invariants.rationale: The method dereferences clusteringGroup to call getSlices(), so it must not be null at method entry.
instantTime is likely required to identify the clustering instant; the method passes it to getRecordIterator.
The method calls clusteringGroup.getSlices().stream(), so getSlices() cannot be null.
Clustering groups are expected to contain at least one slice in typical cluster operations.
instantTime should be a non-empty string to represent a valid timestamp or instant.
